data.name: Constantine
data.gender_notes: Constantine is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Konstantinos means 'infant, constant'. In Latin, the name Constantine is derived from this Greek name and means 'constant, steadfast'. This name became popular in the 4th century when the Roman Emperor Constantine the Great adopted Christianity and made it the religion of the Roman Empire. The name Constantine carries the meaning “Constancy, steadfastness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Constantine usually hope their child will grow to embody constancy, steadfastness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the steadfastness and consistency of faith in God.
data.etymology: Constantine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Constancy, steadfastness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Constantine total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם שמחויוב, יציב, וחזק. שם זה נגזר מהמילה בבווב (kostas) היוונית, אועיםיד (konstantinos) היוונית, בבווב (koustos) הלטינית, אועיםיד (koustos) היוונית. שם זה נקשר לשם האל של קונסטנטין, אויעים (koustos) ועליר (מיגאייי, יבייויבייט), ביויוו (Koustos) ועליר (מיגאייי, יבייויבייט). אויעים (koustos) ועליר (מיגאייי, יבייויבייט) אועיםיויי עויעיםייוייט.

in_greek.name: Κωνσταντῖνος
in_greek.long_meaning: πρέσβυς, πιστός, και αἰώνιος. ὁ ὄνομα Κωνσταντῖνος ἐκφέρθηκε ἀπὸ τὸ ἑλληνικὸν ὄνομα Κωνσταντῖνος. Ἀπὸ τὸ ἔργον σταίνειν, ἕστηκε, καὶ ἀπὸ τὸ ὄνομα Κωνστάντος, ὃ ἐστὶν ἕκτονος, ἡ ἑξῆς. Ἐδῶ, ἡ Ὀνομασία Κωνσταντῖνος εἰς θρόνον, εἰς βασιλείαν, εἰς αἰώνιον βίον. Ὁ Κωνσταντῖνος, εἶναι ὁ ἀπάνθρωπος, ὁ ἀθάνατος, ὁ αἰώνιος. Ἡ ὀνομασία Κωνσταντῖνος, εἰς τὸν Κωνσταντῖνον, εἶναι ὁ Ὄνομα, ὁ αἰώνιος.

in_english.name: Constantine
in_english.meaning: constant, strong, and eternal, steadfast, and firm
in_english.long_meaning: constant, strong, and eternal, steadfast, and firm. The name Constantine is derived from the Greek name Κωνσταντίνος (Kōnstantinos), which is itself derived from the Latin name Constantius. From the Latin word 'constare', to stand firm, to stand, from the Latin word 'constant', which means steadfast, firm, abiding. In Latin, the name Constantine means 'constant, strong, and eternal'. The name Constantine is associated with the biblical figure of Constantine, who was a Roman emperor and the first Christian emperor. He was known for his military victories and his conversion to Christianity. The name Constantine is also associated with the concept of eternal life, and is often used to signify strength, courage, and perseverance.

data.cultural_impact: The cultural impact of the name Constantine is largely due to the historical figure Constantine the Great, who was the first Christian Roman Emperor. He is credited with moving the Roman Empire's capital city from Rome to Constantinople (now Istanbul, Turkey), which became a major cultural melting pot and hub of the Eastern Roman Empire. Constantine's conversion to Christianity and issuing the Edict of Milan in 313 AD, granting religious tolerance, significantly influenced the spread of Christianity throughout the Roman Empire and beyond.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Constantine carries a deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the steadfastness and constancy of the Roman Emperor who helped establish Christianity as the dominant religion in the Roman Empire. His conversion and actions led to the formal recognition and spread of Christianity, making it an essential part of global culture and spiritual beliefs. Constantine's story also demonstrates the power and influence a single individual can have on shaping history and the world's religious landscape.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Constantine: Steadfast in Christ. A symbol of unwavering faith and devotion to God. The name Constantine is a reminder to remain steadfast in our beliefs and to hold firm in our faith during times of adversity.

biblical_reference.note: This name is associated with the Roman Emperor Constantine, who was a prominent figure in early Christian history, but is not directly mentioned in the Bible.

historical_references.reference: Constantine the Great is traditionally identified as the first Christian Roman Emperor. He was born in Naissus (modern Niš, Serbia) in AD 272 and ruled the Roman Empire from AD 306 to 337.
historical_references.context: Constantine converted to Christianity during the later years of his rule, adopting it as the state religion of the empire in AD 313, after the Edict of Milan.

historical_references.reference: According to legend, Constantine had a vision of a cross before a battle in AD 312, which he interpreted as a sign from God to use the symbol of the cross in his army. This is said to have led to his conversion to Christianity and his subsequent edict granting religious tolerance to Christians.
historical_references.context: The legend of Constantine's vision and subsequent conversion to Christianity is not substantiated by historical evidence, but it has remained a popular narrative in Christian tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern context, the name Constantine is often associated with Constantine the Great, the Roman Emperor who converted to Christianity and is credited for spreading the religion throughout the Roman Empire. The name is seen on various platforms including education where students learn about the historical significance of Constantine in the context of the Byzantine Empire and Early Christianity. In the gaming industry, there are games based on Constantine's life and his role in the spread of Christianity. Lastly, in the media, Constantine is a popular name for various works of fiction, such as graphic novels, movies, and TV shows, where the character is often depicted as a powerful and influential figure.
